title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 Full Length Mock Test 17 (Hard Level)
description: Hard Level Full Length Mock Test for SSC CHSL Tier-1 as per latest pattern.
instructions: Yeh Hard Level Full Length Mock Test hai.
Total 100 questions: Reasoning 25, General Awareness 25, Quantitative Aptitude 25, English 25.
Har question 2 marks ka hai. Galat jawab par 0.5 marks katenge.
SSC CHSL Tier-1 latest pattern ke anusar.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Book : Author :: Painting : ?
questions.explanation: A book is created by an author; a painting is created by an artist.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the odd one out: Apple, Mango, Orange, Potato
questions.explanation: Potato is a vegetable; others are fruits.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: What comes next in the series: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ?
questions.explanation: Differences: 4, 6, 8, 10, next difference 12 → 30+12=42.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If CAT is coded as 3120, how is DOG coded?

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Pointing to a man, a woman said, 'His mother is the only daughter of my mother.' How is the man related to the woman?
questions.explanation: Only daughter of woman's mother is the woman herself, so the man is her son.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A man walks 5 km north, then 3 km east, then 5 km south. How far is he from the starting point?
questions.explanation: He ends up 3 km east of the starting point.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statements: All pens are books. Some books are pencils. Conclusions: I. Some pens are pencils. II. All pencils are books.
questions.explanation: Neither conclusion follows definitively from the given statements.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: In a row of 40 students, A is 15th from the left and B is 20th from the right. How many students are between A and B?
questions.explanation: B is 20th from right means 21st from left (40-20+1=21). Students between 15 and 21: 5.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Pen : Write :: Knife : ?
questions.explanation: Pen is used to write; knife is used to cut.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the missing number: 5, 11, 23, 47, ?

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: In a certain code, TREE is written as 20-18-5-5. How is LEAF written?

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If the word 'MIRROR' is seen in a mirror, which of the following would be its reflection?
questions.explanation: Mirror image reverses the order of letters.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If 1st January 2025 is a Wednesday, what day will 1st January 2026 be?
questions.explanation: 2025 is not a leap year, so 365 days = 52 weeks +1 day. Next year starts on Thursday.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Five friends A, B, C, D, E are sitting in a row. A is to the left of B, C is to the right of B, D is between A and B, E is at the extreme right. Who is at the extreme left?
questions.explanation: Order: A, D, B, C, E. Extreme left is A.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the odd one: 16, 25, 36, 49, 64, 81
questions.explanation: All are perfect squares.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Doctor : Hospital :: Teacher : ?
questions.explanation: Doctor works in hospital; teacher works in school.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: What is the next term: AZ, BY, CX, DW, ?
questions.explanation: First letter +1, second letter -1: E, V.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A is B's sister. C is B's mother. D is C's father. E is D's mother. How is A related to D?
questions.explanation: A is daughter of C, C is daughter of D, so A is granddaughter of D.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A person starts from point P, walks 10 m south, then 15 m east, then 10 m north. How far and in which direction is he from P?
questions.explanation: Net displacement is 15 m east.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If in a code language, 'APPLE' is written as 'ELPPA', then 'MANGO' will be written as?
questions.explanation: Letters are reversed.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Which of the following is different from the others?
questions.explanation: Circle is curved; others are polygons with straight sides.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Which diagram best represents the relationship between Doctors, Males, and Females?
options: Doctors intersecting both Males and Females separately
questions.explanation: Doctors can be male or female, so Doctors circle intersects both.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: In a class of 50 students, Rohan ranks 15th from the top. What is his rank from the bottom?
questions.explanation: Rank from bottom = 50 - 15 + 1 = 36.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statement: All roses are flowers. Some flowers fade quickly. Conclusion: Some roses fade quickly.
questions.explanation: The conclusion does not necessarily follow.

questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
questions.question: A can do a work in 10 days and B in 15 days. In how many days can they complete it together?
questions.explanation: A's 1 day work = 1/10, B's = 1/15. Together = 1/10 + 1/15 = 1/6. So 6 days.

questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
questions.question: The ratio of ages of A and B is 3:5. If B is 20 years old, what is A's age?
questions.explanation: 5 parts = 20 → 1 part = 4 → 3 parts = 12.

questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
questions.question: The average of 5 numbers is 20. If one number is excluded, the average becomes 18. What is the excluded number?
questions.explanation: Total of 5 = 100. Total of 4 = 72. Excluded = 100-72=28.

questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
questions.question: A train travels 120 km in 2 hours. What is its speed in km/h?
questions.explanation: Speed = Distance/Time = 120/2 = 60 km/h.

questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
questions.question: What is the area of a circle with radius 7 cm? (Use π=22/7)
questions.explanation: Area = πr² = 22/7 × 49 = 154 cm².

questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
questions.question: What is the LCM of 12 and 18?
questions.explanation: LCM of 12 and 18 is 36.

questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
questions.question: A number is increased by 20% and then decreased by 20%. What is the net change?
questions.explanation: Net effect = 20 - 20 - (20×20)/100 = -4%. Decrease of 4%.
